events.headline: US PAUSES PLAN TO GUIDE SHIPS THROUGH THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ
events.detail: Donald Trump has said that the US military operation guiding ships through the Strait of Hormuz will be paused.

events.headline: WHAT IS TRUMP'S 'PROJECT FREEDOM' IN THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ?
events.detail: The US president said the operation has been paused after starting on Monday.

events.headline: IRAN WAR LIVE: TRUMP SAYS HORMUZ OPERATION PAUSED AMID US, TEHRAN TALKS
events.detail: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth says ceasefire with Iran remains in place despite growing tensions in Hormuz Strait.

events.headline: TRUMP PAUSES US OPERATION IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ IN PUSH FOR DEAL WITH IRAN
events.detail: US president says 'Project Freedom' suspended to see whether an agreement with Iran can be finalised and signed.

events.headline: TRUMP PAUSES US MILITARY ESCORTS IN HORMUZ
events.detail: The US president has paused his Project Freedom in the Strait of Hormuz, but said the blockade of Iranian ports would “remain in full force” Read Full Article at RT.com

events.headline: TRUMP PONE EN PAUSA LA MISIÓN PARA GUIAR A BUQUES MERCANTES EN ORMUZ
events.detail: El secretario de Estado, Marco Rubio, había asegurado que el Proyecto Libertad para guiar a buques mercantes por el estrecho es una medida defensiva y necesaria para garantizar la libre navegación
